subject: Urban Planning
title: Brasília: A Capital Built from Nothing
description: A short lesson to help you apply Brasília: A Capital Built from Nothing.

hook.text: In 1960, Brazil built an entire capital city in the middle of nowhere in just 41 months.

buildup.text: Lúcio Costa designed it in the shape of an airplane. Oscar Niemeyer designed every major building.

discovery.text: Superquadras — residential blocks surrounded by greenery — replaced traditional streets entirely.

twist.text: The car-centric design left pedestrians stranded. Workers who built it couldn't afford to live there.

climax.text: Satellite cities of favelas grew around Brasília, recreating the inequality it was meant to erase.

punchline.text: A city shaped like a plane. Nobody walks in it.

quiz.question: What shape was Brasília designed in?
options: A star with five radiating avenues
An airplane or bird with two wings
A circle with concentric ring roads
